CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `token_costs` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `action` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `cost` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `label` varchar(64),
  `isEnabled` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `token_costs_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `token_costs_action_unique` UNIQUE(`action`)
);

INSERT IGNORE INTO `token_costs` (`action`, `cost`, `label`, `isEnabled`) VALUES

  ('ai_refine', 2, 'AI Refine (Edit DXF)', 1),
  ('face_detect', 4, 'Face/Portrait Detection', 1),
  ('convert', 0, 'Basic Convert (Free)', 1);
